trailhead.label: The dirt car park just past the Campoè sanctuary above Caglio, the published start

cautions: The first stretch follows the access road past the Chalet restaurant: keep your dog close.
A rope adventure park beside the track in the chestnut wood: keep your dog on a short lead past it.
The paved mule track can be slippery with wet leaves.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.The dirt car park just past the Campoè s: Il parcheggio sterrato subito dopo il santuario di Campoè sopra Caglio, la partenza pubblicata
textIt.The first stretch follows the access roa: Il primo tratto segue la strada d'accesso oltre il ristorante Chalet: tieni il cane vicino.
textIt.A rope adventure park beside the track i: Un parco avventura sulle corde accanto alla sterrata nel castagneto: passandoci accanto tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.The paved mule track can be slippery wit: La mulattiera lastricata può essere scivolosa con le foglie bagnate.
